There's at least a few people out there who recently found themselves constantly being redirected to preview.voat.co even after the recent update was finished.

This was due to a 301 permanent redirect being used mistakenly, instead of a 302 temporary redirect.

After some pondering over possible fixes and trying to work out the most user-friendly approach to fixing the issue, during which some sources said that a browser cache clear would work and some said it wouldn't, I decided to do some testing.

I have determined through testing on a web server similar to the deployment of Voat and using my Android mobile, that a simple browser cache clear will almost definitely fix the issue in most cases. This is good because it removes the need to access browser development tools – which can be a pain in the butt for mobile users.

 

Here are the instructions needed to clear only the cache (removing the permanent redirect instruction) of several different browsers on an Android device, unfortunately I don't have an Apple device handy to test with but I imagine the process and results will be damn near identical:

Samsung Internet Explorer:

  1. Press the icon with 3 horizontal lines in the bottom right of the browser.
  2. Press Settings.
  3. Press Privacy & Security.
  4. Press Delete Browsing Data.
  5. Uncheck all options except "cache".
  6. Press "Delete".
  7. You should now be able to visit all areas of https://voat.co which you normally have access to without being redirected to the preview site.

Mozilla Firefox:

  1. Press the icon with 3 dots arranged vertically in the top right of the browser.
  2. Press Settings.
  3. Press Clear Private Data.
  4. Uncheck all options except "cache".
  5. Press "Clear".
  6. You should now be able to visit all areas of https://voat.co which you normally have access to without being redirected to the preview site.

Brave Browser:

  1. Press the icon with 3 dots arranged vertically in the bottom right of the browser.
  2. Press Settings.
  3. Press Privacy.
  4. Press Clear Browsing Data.
  5. Select "All Time" for the time range.
  6. Uncheck all options except "Cached images & files".
  7. Press "Clear Data".
  8. You should now be able to visit all areas of https://voat.co which you normally have access to without being redirected to the preview site.

Google Chrome:

  1. Press the icon with 3 dots arranged vertically in the top right of the browser.
  2. Press Settings.
  3. Press Privacy.
  4. Press Clear Browsing Data.
  5. Select "All Time" for the time range.
  6. Uncheck all options except "Cached images & files".
  7. Press "Clear Data".
  8. You should now be able to visit all areas of https://voat.co which you normally have access to without being redirected to the preview site.

 

If for some reason the issue persists for your browser of choice, there's 2 other options available which may help in the mean time:

  • Load your browser in private/incognito mode.
  • Install a fresh copy of an alternate browser for use with https://voat.co.
